utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s Sunday at the community center, and we’re especially short on people to sort tools and greet folks at check-in. If you can help there, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I can sort tools and help at check-in today. Just point me where you need me first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming: we’re starting with the leaky sink and the front door hinge, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes — those are the first two priorities. I’m still making the list of anything else the repair drive needs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and we could really use help sorting tools and greeting folks at check-in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Rosa — I can help sort tools and greet people at check-in on Sunday. Just let me know what time you’d like me there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tell me what the repair drive needs most, and I’ll check what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: We could really use sturdy boxes, packing tape, and a few basic hand tools if you’ve got any spares. Even a roll of tape or a clean tote would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I can send the repair drive details again and make sure everything is clear.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — could you send the time, location, and what items you’re collecting again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal. We still need a few basic tools and some sturdy supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’m tracking the basic tools and sturdy supplies for the repair drive. Send me the locations when you have them, and I’ll keep them noted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Dane — let’s start with nails, tarps, tape, and a few working tools. I’ll sort the rest once we know what’s on hand.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll help track down nails, tarps, tape, and any working tools we can still use.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, Jules — the tape and sturdy box would help a lot. I’ll send over the locations I have for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll get the tape and box ready, and I’ll keep an eye out for your locations.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could you check the nails and tape first, Leo? I’m trying to keep the list tight so we don’t miss the basics.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’ll check the nails and tape first, then I’ll confirm what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the repair drive details and spread the invite too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — I’ll bring my tool kit and be ready for the biggest fixes first. Just send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: We’re mainly collecting usable tools, fasteners, and small appliance parts right now. If you’ve got anything like that, I can sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works, Bo. I’ll keep the list tidy and send over the locations we’ve got so far.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What are you short on most for the repair drive?
